aboutMe:
I am a Senior Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience building scalable backend systems and reusable frameworks using Node.js and ReactJS. Currently working at IBM India Software Labs in Bengaluru, I specialize in connector platform development, API design, and automated testing.

My expertise includes designing stream-based file upload frameworks, building internal development sandboxes, and architecting connector service frameworks that have delivered up to 80% cost and development time reduction. I'm proud to have received the Client and Partner Success Award – 2024 at IBM for my impactful contributions to IBM Watson Orchestrate.

I hold an M.Tech in Computer Science from the prestigious International Institute of Information Technology, Bangalore (IIIT-B), where I developed a strong foundation in system design, algorithms, and distributed systems.

I'm passionate about building reliable, scalable solutions and collaborating across teams to deliver high-impact results. Let's connect and explore opportunities to work together!

professionalProjects.projectDescription: Architected a comprehensive connector service framework integrating IBM App Connect connectors with IBM Watson Orchestrate. Exposed connector capabilities as Open API 3.0 descriptors with organization-specific annotations, enabling workflow orchestration and achieving ~80% cost reduction through reuse.

Designed and implemented an innovative stream-based file upload solution for multiple connectors, overcoming the 10MB buffering limitation. Converted file payloads into streams, supported bounded/unbounded endpoints, and enabled claim-check pattern for large file transfers.

Designed a comprehensive base JDBC framework for IBM App Connect to standardize database connectivity, transaction management, and CRUD/custom SQL execution. This framework became the foundation for multiple database connectors.

Built an internal Dev Sandbox replicating the test environment with the latest production UI and backend code, enabling local end-to-end testing of connector and framework changes using ReactJS and Node.js.
professionalProjects.impact: 85% reduction in development and debugging time

personalProjects.projectDescription: An open-source React-based portfolio template that enables developers to quickly build professional portfolio websites. Features a configuration-driven approach, modern UI components with Framer Motion animations, and fully responsive design. Demonstrates full-stack development skills and commitment to open-source contribution.

A full-featured e-commerce platform built with React for the frontend and Node.js for the backend. Implements secure authentication, payment processing, product management, and order tracking. Demonstrates expertise in building scalable, production-ready applications.

Developed an intelligent chatbot using IBM Watson Assistant and natural language processing. The chatbot provides automated customer support with context-aware responses and integrates with multiple communication channels.

Collection of ML projects including predictive analytics, classification models, and data visualization. Implemented various algorithms for real-world problem-solving using Python and popular ML libraries.

Interactive web application to visualize sorting and searching algorithms. Helps students and developers understand algorithm behavior through step-by-step visual representations with adjustable speed controls.

blogs.blogTitle: Building Scalable Connector Frameworks: Lessons from IBM Watson Orchestrate
blogs.blogDescription: An in-depth exploration of designing and implementing connector service frameworks that enable seamless integration between enterprise applications. This article covers architectural decisions, performance optimizations, and best practices for building reusable, scalable integration solutions that reduce development time by up to 80%.

blogs.blogTitle: Using IBM® App Connect to interact with IBM DB2 onCloud
blogs.blogDescription: A comprehensive guide on leveraging IBM App Connect for seamless database integration. As the lead developer of the IBM DB2 connector, I share insights into the design, implementation, and deployment of JDBC-based connectors. This article demonstrates the connector's capabilities and provides practical examples for enterprise integration scenarios.
